title: Cloud Security: availability credit bands
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for availability credit bands.

## Basis

Monthly availability target percentage: Monthly availability percentage above which no outage credit is due; decimal.

Descending availability credit bands: Descending lower-inclusive availability thresholds and credit fractions below the SLA target; mapping list.

Cumulative outage credit cap fraction: Maximum cumulative outage credit fraction of the source charge net service subtotal; decimal.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Monthly availability target percentage | Descending availability credit bands | Cumulative outage credit cap fraction |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 99.9 | availability minimum 99.0, credit fraction 0.1; availability minimum 95.0, credit fraction 0.2; availability minimum 0.0, credit fraction 0.3 | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 99.9 | availability minimum 99.0, credit fraction 0.1; availability minimum 95.0, credit fraction 0.2; availability minimum 0.0, credit fraction 0.3 | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 99.9 | availability minimum 99.0, credit fraction 0.1; availability minimum 95.0, credit fraction 0.2; availability minimum 0.0, credit fraction 0.3 | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 99.9 | availability minimum 99.0, credit fraction 0.1; availability minimum 95.0, credit fraction 0.2; availability minimum 0.0, credit fraction 0.3 | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 99.9 | availability minimum 99.0, credit fraction 0.1; availability minimum 95.0, credit fraction 0.2; availability minimum 0.0, credit fraction 0.3 | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 99.9 | availability minimum 99.0, credit fraction 0.1; availability minimum 95.0, credit fraction 0.2; availability minimum 0.0, credit fraction 0.3 | 0.3 |

## Tier comparison

The listed availability credit bands bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
